anomalies.observed: On the root sheet (Capacitive Touch Button block), the left terminal of the 1 kΩ series resistor R9 is joined to BOTH net labels NET0011 (U3 pin 57, PB5) and NET0013 (U3 pin 59, PB7); the 22 nF capacitor C2 also hangs off this same node to GND, and R9's right terminal drives A3 pin 'BTN'. Thus PB5 and PB7 are shorted together and the TSC sampling capacitor sits on the same node as the electrode drive path.
anomalies.expected: The specification defines two separate TSC nets: 'TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN' and 'TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND)'. The drive pin (PB5, through the series R to the electrode) and the sampling-capacitor pin (PB7, with C to GND) must not be connected to each other.

evidence.quote: Capacitive Touch Button (TSC) block, root sheet PCB.kicad_sch: NET0011 and NET0013 labels both wired to the left terminal of R9 (1k); C2 (22n) between that node and GND; R9 right terminal to A3 'BTN'.
TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin 'BTN' ... TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group

anomalies.impact: The MCU's TSC drive pin (PB5) and sampling pin (PB7) are shorted through R9 and the electrode, and the sampling capacitor is placed on the wrong node. The capacitive-touch sensing channel will not operate correctly (the TSC peripheral cannot charge/discharge the electrode and sampling cap independently), so the touch button is non-functional and the two GPIOs are tied together.

parsed.summary: The NFC, display (including SSD1306 I2C strapping and charge-pump network), SWD connector and decoupling all match the specification; the only deviation I found is in the capacitive-touch block, where the 1 kΩ series resistor's input node joins both the electrode-drive pin (PB5/NET0011) and the sampling-capacitor pin (PB7/NET0013), shorting the two TSC group pins together instead of keeping them separate as the spec requires.
